# performance

Read and follow [the canonical `performance` skill](../../../agentic-craft/skills/performance/SKILL.md) from the pinned agentic-craft kit (if it's missing, run `git submodule update --init agentic-craft`). Its own links resolve beside it.

This repository's rules come first: AGENTS.md, "Agent kits", and the documents it names. Benchmarks are `npm run perf:bench` (baseline `perf/baseline.json`, budgets `perf/budgets.json`), the planet's `npm run perf:audit` and `npm run verify:prod`'s bundle budgets. Nothing visible changes for performance without the owner's sign-off.
